versos.grego: Ὦ ἀνόητοι Γαλάται, τίς ὑμᾶς ἐβάσκανεν, οἷς κατ’ ὀφθαλμοὺς Ἰησοῦς Χριστὸς προεγράφη ἐσταυρωμένος;

controles.web: Foolish Galatians, who has bewitched you not to obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ was openly portrayed among you as crucified?
controles.kjv: O foolish Galatians, who hath bewitched you, that ye should not obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ hath been evidently set forth, crucified among you?
controles.livre: Ó insensatos gálatas, quem vos iludiu  ?  Diante dos vossos olhos Jesus Cristo foi retratado  como crucificado!

versos.grego: τοῦτο μόνον θέλω μαθεῖν ἀφ’ ὑμῶν, ἐξ ἔργων νόμου τὸ Πνεῦμα ἐλάβετε ἢ ἐξ ἀκοῆς πίστεως;

controles.web: I just want to learn this from you. Did you receive the Spirit by the works of the law, or by hearing of faith?
controles.kjv: This only would I learn of you, Received ye the Spirit by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?
controles.livre: Só isto eu queria saber de vós: recebestes o Espírito pelas obras da Lei ou pela pregação da fé?

versos.grego: οὕτως ἀνόητοί ἐστε; ἐναρξάμενοι Πνεύματι νῦν σαρκὶ ἐπιτελεῖσθε;

controles.web: Are you so foolish? Having begun in the Spirit, are you now completed in the flesh?
controles.kjv: Are ye so foolish? having begun in the Spirit, are ye now made perfect by the flesh?
controles.livre: Sois vós tão insensatos que, depois de começardes no Espírito, agora terminareis na carne?

versos.grego: τοσαῦτα ἐπάθετε εἰκῇ; εἴ γε καὶ εἰκῇ.

controles.web: Did you suffer so many things in vain, if it is indeed in vain?
controles.kjv: Have ye suffered so many things in vain? if it be yet in vain.
controles.livre: Experimentastes  tantas coisas em vão? Se é que foi mesmo em vão!

versos.grego: ὁ οὖν ἐπιχορηγῶν ὑμῖν τὸ Πνεῦμα καὶ ἐνεργῶν δυνάμεις ἐν ὑμῖν, ἐξ ἔργων νόμου ἢ ἐξ ἀκοῆς πίστεως;

controles.web: He therefore who supplies the Spirit to you, and works miracles among you, does he do it by the works of the law, or by hearing of faith?
controles.kjv: He therefore that ministereth to you the Spirit, and worketh miracles among you, doeth he it by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?
controles.livre: Ora, aquele que vos dá o Espírito e que opera maravilhas entre vós faz isso por causa das obras da Lei ou da pregação da fé?

versos.grego: καθὼς Ἀβραὰμ ἐπίστευσεν τῷ Θεῷ, καὶ ἐλογίσθη αὐτῷ εἰς δικαιοσύνην.

controles.web: Even as Abraham “believed God, and it was counted to him for righteousness.”
controles.kjv: Even as Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him for righteousness.
controles.livre: Assim como “Abraão creu em Deus, e foi lhe reputado como justiça”,

versos.grego: Γινώσκετε ἄρα ὅτι οἱ ἐκ πίστεως, οὗτοι υἱοί εἰσιν Ἀβραάμ.

controles.web: Know therefore that those who are of faith, the same are children of Abraham.
controles.kjv: Know ye therefore that they which are of faith, the same are the children of Abraham.
controles.livre: entendei, pois, que os que são da fé são filhos de Abraão.

versos.grego: προϊδοῦσα δὲ ἡ γραφὴ ὅτι ἐκ πίστεως δικαιοῖ τὰ ἔθνη ὁ Θεὸς, προευηγγελίσατο τῷ Ἀβραὰμ ὅτι Ἐνευλογηθήσονται ἐν σοὶ πάντα τὰ ἔθνη.

controles.web: The Scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the Gentiles by faith, preached the Good News beforehand to Abraham, saying, “In you all the nations will be blessed.”
controles.kjv: And the scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the heathen through faith, preached before the gospel unto Abraham, saying, In thee shall all nations be blessed.
controles.livre: E a Escritura, prevendo que Deus justificaria os gentios pela fé, prenunciou o Evangelho a Abraão, dizendo : Todas nas nações serão abençoadas em ti.

versos.grego: ὥστε οἱ ἐκ πίστεως εὐλογοῦνται σὺν τῷ πιστῷ Ἀβραάμ.

controles.web: So then, those who are of faith are blessed with the faithful Abraham.
controles.kjv: So then they which be of faith are blessed with faithful Abraham.
controles.livre: Portanto, os que são da fé são abençoados com o crente Abraão.

versos.grego: Ὅσοι γὰρ ἐξ ἔργων νόμου εἰσὶν, ὑπὸ κατάραν εἰσίν, γέγραπται γὰρ ὅτι Ἐπικατάρατος πᾶς ὃς οὐκ ἐμμένει πᾶσιν τοῖς γεγραμμένοις ἐν τῷ βιβλίῳ τοῦ νόμου τοῦ ποιῆσαι αὐτά.

controles.web: For as many as are of the works of the law are under a curse. For it is written, “Cursed is everyone who doesn’t continue in all things that are written in the book of the law, to do them.”
controles.kjv: For as many as are of the works of the law are under the curse: for it is written, Cursed is every one that continueth not in all things which are written in the book of the law to do them.
controles.livre: Pois todos os que são das obras da Lei estão sob maldição, porque está escrito: Maldito todo aquele que não permanecer em todas as coisas que estão escritas no livro da Lei, para fazê-las.

versos.grego: ὅτι δὲ ἐν νόμῳ οὐδεὶς δικαιοῦται παρὰ τῷ Θεῷ δῆλον, ὅτι Ὁ δίκαιος ἐκ πίστεως ζήσεται·

controles.web: Now that no man is justified by the law before God is evident, for, “The righteous will live by faith.”
controles.kjv: But that no man is justified by the law in the sight of God, it is evident: for, The just shall live by faith.
controles.livre: E é evidente que pela Lei ninguém será justificado, porque: O justo viverá pela fé.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ νόμος οὐκ ἔστιν ἐκ πίστεως, ἀλλ’ Ὁ ποιήσας αὐτὰ ζήσεται ἐν αὐτοῖς.

controles.web: The law is not of faith, but, “The man who does them will live by them.”
controles.kjv: And the law is not of faith: but, The man that doeth them shall live in them.
controles.livre: A Lei não provém  da fé; porém: Quem fizer estas coisas por elas viverá.

versos.grego: Χριστὸς ἡμᾶς ἐξηγόρασεν ἐκ τῆς κατάρας τοῦ νόμου γενόμενος ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν κατάρα, ὅτι γέγραπται Ἐπικατάρατος πᾶς ὁ κρεμάμενος ἐπὶ ξύλου,

controles.web: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law, having become a curse for us. For it is written, “Cursed is everyone who hangs on a tree,”
controles.kjv: Christ hath redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a curse for us: for it is written, Cursed is every one that hangeth on a tree:
controles.livre: Cristo nos resgatou da maldição da Lei ao se fazer maldição para o nosso benefício (pois está escrito: Maldito todo aquele que for pendurado em um madeiro.)

versos.grego: ἵνα εἰς τὰ ἔθνη ἡ εὐλογία τοῦ Ἀβραὰμ γένηται ἐν Ἰησοῦ Χριστῷ, ἵνα τὴν ἐπαγγελίαν τοῦ Πνεύματος λάβωμεν διὰ τῆς πίστεως.

controles.web: that the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Christ Jesus; that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.
controles.kjv: That the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Jesus Christ; that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.
controles.livre: com a finalidade de que a bênção de Abraão chegasse aos gentios em Jesus Cristo, para que recebêssemos a promessa do Espírito  por meio da fé.

versos.grego: Ἀδελφοί, κατὰ ἄνθρωπον λέγω. ὅμως ἀνθρώπου κεκυρωμένην διαθήκην οὐδεὶς ἀθετεῖ ἢ ἐπιδιατάσσεται.

controles.web: Brothers, speaking of human terms, though it is only a man’s covenant, yet when it has been confirmed, no one makes it void, or adds to it.
controles.kjv: Brethren, I speak after the manner of men; Though it be but a man’s covenant, yet if it be confirmed, no man disannulleth, or addeth thereto.
controles.livre: Irmãos, estou falando em termos humanos: ainda que seja o pacto de uma pessoa, depois de confirmado, ninguém o anula, nem lhe acrescenta.

versos.grego: τῷ δὲ Ἀβραὰμ ἐρρέθησαν αἱ ἐπαγγελίαι καὶ τῷ σπέρματι αὐτοῦ. οὐ λέγει Καὶ τοῖς σπέρμασιν, ὡς ἐπὶ πολλῶν, ἀλλ’ ὡς ἐφ’ ἑνός Καὶ τῷ σπέρματί σου, ὅς ἐστιν Χριστός.

controles.web: Now the promises were spoken to Abraham and to his seed. He doesn’t say, “To seeds”, as of many, but as of one, “To your seed”, which is Christ.
controles.kjv: Now to Abraham and his seed were the promises made. He saith not, And to seeds, as of many; but as of one, And to thy seed, which is Christ.
controles.livre: Ora, as promessas foram ditas a Abraão e à sua descendência.  E não diz: “E às descendências”  como que falando de muitos, mas sim como a um: “E à tua descendência”,  que é Cristo.

versos.grego: τοῦτο δὲ λέγω· διαθήκην προκεκυρωμένην ὑπὸ τοῦ Θεοῦ ὁ μετὰ τετρακόσια καὶ τριάκοντα ἔτη γεγονὼς νόμος οὐκ ἀκυροῖ, εἰς τὸ καταργῆσαι τὴν ἐπαγγελίαν.

controles.web: Now I say this. A covenant confirmed beforehand by God in Christ, the law, which came four hundred thirty years after, does not annul, so as to make the promise of no effect.
controles.kjv: And this I say, that the covenant, that was confirmed before of God in Christ, the law, which was four hundred and thirty years after, cannot disannul, that it should make the promise of none effect.
controles.livre: Mas digo isto: o pacto foi confirmado anteriormente por Deus ;  e a Lei que veio quatrocentos e trinta anos depois não o invalida de maneira que anule a promessa.

versos.grego: εἰ γὰρ ἐκ νόμου ἡ κληρονομία, οὐκέτι ἐξ ἐπαγγελίας· τῷ δὲ Ἀβραὰμ δι’ ἐπαγγελίας κεχάρισται ὁ Θεός.

controles.web: For if the inheritance is of the law, it is no more of promise; but God has granted it to Abraham by promise.
controles.kjv: For if the inheritance be of the law, it is no more of promise: but God gave it to Abraham by promise.
controles.livre: Pois, se a herança é pela Lei, já não é pela promessa; mas foi por meio da promessa que Deus a concedeu gratuitamente a Abraão.

versos.grego: Τί οὖν ὁ νόμος; τῶν παραβάσεων χάριν προσετέθη, ἄχρις ἂν ἔλθῃ τὸ σπέρμα ᾧ ἐπήγγελται, διαταγεὶς δι’ ἀγγέλων ἐν χειρὶ μεσίτου.

controles.web: What then is the law? It was added because of transgressions, until the seed should come to whom the promise has been made. It was ordained through angels by the hand of a mediator.
controles.kjv: Wherefore then serveth the law? It was added because of transgressions, till the seed should come to whom the promise was made; and it was ordained by angels in the hand of a mediator.
controles.livre: Para que, pois, é a Lei? Ela foi ordenada por causa das transgressões, até que chegasse o descendente  a quem a promessa havia sido feita; e foi posta pelos anjos na mão de um mediador.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ μεσίτης ἑνὸς οὐκ ἔστιν, ὁ δὲ Θεὸς εἷς ἐστιν.

controles.web: Now a mediator is not between one, but God is one.
controles.kjv: Now a mediator is not a mediator of one, but God is one.
controles.livre: Ora, o mediador não é de um só, mas Deus é um.

versos.grego: ὁ οὖν νόμος κατὰ τῶν ἐπαγγελιῶν τοῦ Θεοῦ; μὴ γένοιτο. εἰ γὰρ ἐδόθη νόμος ὁ δυνάμενος ζωοποιῆσαι, ὄντως ἐκ νόμου ἂν ἦν ἡ δικαιοσύνη·

controles.web: Is the law then against the promises of God? Certainly not! For if there had been a law given which could make alive, most certainly righteousness would have been of the law.
controles.kjv: Is the law then against the promises of God? God forbid: for if there had been a law given which could have given life, verily righteousness should have been by the law.
controles.livre: Acaso, pois, a Lei é contra as promessas de Deus? De maneira nenhuma! Pois, se a Lei houvesse sido entregue para que pudesse dar vida, na verdade a justiça teria sido pela Lei.

versos.grego: ἀλλὰ συνέκλεισεν ἡ γραφὴ τὰ πάντα ὑπὸ ἁμαρτίαν ἵνα ἡ ἐπαγγελία ἐκ πίστεως Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ δοθῇ τοῖς πιστεύουσιν.

controles.web: But the Scriptures imprisoned all things under sin, that the promise by faith in Jesus Christ might be given to those who believe.
controles.kjv: But the scripture hath concluded all under sin, that the promise by faith of Jesus Christ might be given to them that believe.
controles.livre: Mas a Escritura prendeu tudo debaixo do pecado a fim de que a promessa fosse dada aos crentes por meio da fé em Jesus Cristo.

versos.grego: Πρὸ τοῦ δὲ ἐλθεῖν τὴν πίστιν ὑπὸ νόμον ἐφρουρούμεθα συνκλειόμενοι εἰς τὴν μέλλουσαν πίστιν ἀποκαλυφθῆναι.

controles.web: But before faith came, we were kept in custody under the law, confined for the faith which should afterwards be revealed.
controles.kjv: But before faith came, we were kept under the law, shut up unto the faith which should afterwards be revealed.
controles.livre: Porém, antes que a fé viesse, estávamos vigiados sob a Lei, e presos, até que a fé fosse revelada.

versos.grego: ὥστε ὁ νόμος παιδαγωγὸς ἡμῶν γέγονεν εἰς Χριστόν, ἵνα ἐκ πίστεως δικαιωθῶμεν·

controles.web: So that the law has become our tutor to bring us to Christ, that we might be justified by faith.
controles.kjv: Wherefore the law was our schoolmaster to bring us unto Christ, that we might be justified by faith.
controles.livre: Dessa maneira, a Lei foi nosso tutor em condução a Cristo, para que pela fé fossemos justificados.

versos.grego: ἐλθούσης δὲ τῆς πίστεως οὐκέτι ὑπὸ παιδαγωγόν ἐσμεν.

controles.web: But now that faith has come, we are no longer under a tutor.
controles.kjv: But after that faith is come, we are no longer under a schoolmaster.
controles.livre: Mas depois que a fé chegou, já não estamos mais sob um tutor,

versos.grego: Πάντες γὰρ υἱοὶ Θεοῦ ἐστε διὰ τῆς πίστεως ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ·

controles.web: For you are all children of God, through faith in Christ Jesus.
controles.kjv: For ye are all the children of God by faith in Christ Jesus.
controles.livre: pois todos vós sois filhos de Deus por meio da fé em Cristo Jesus;

versos.grego: ὅσοι γὰρ εἰς Χριστὸν ἐβαπτίσθητε, Χριστὸν ἐνεδύσασθε.

controles.web: For as many of you as were baptized into Christ have put on Christ.
controles.kjv: For as many of you as have been baptized into Christ have put on Christ.
controles.livre: pois todos vós que fostes batizados em Cristo já vos revestistes de Cristo.

versos.grego: οὐκ ἔνι Ἰουδαῖος οὐδὲ Ἕλλην, οὐκ ἔνι δοῦλος οὐδὲ ἐλεύθερος, οὐκ ἔνι ἄρσεν καὶ θῆλυ· πάντες γὰρ ὑμεῖς εἷς ἐστε ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ.

controles.web: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither slave nor free man, there is neither male nor female; for you are all one in Christ Jesus.
controles.kjv: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither bond nor free, there is neither male nor female: for ye are all one in Christ Jesus.
controles.livre: Assim, não há judeu nem grego; não há servo nem livre; não há macho nem fêmea. Pois todos vós sois um em Cristo Jesus.

versos.grego: εἰ δὲ ὑμεῖς Χριστοῦ, ἄρα τοῦ Ἀβραὰμ σπέρμα ἐστέ, κατ’ ἐπαγγελίαν κληρονόμοι.

controles.web: If you are Christ’s, then you are Abraham’s seed and heirs according to promise.
controles.kjv: And if ye be Christ’s, then are ye Abraham’s seed, and heirs according to the promise.
controles.livre: E, se vós sois de Cristo, então sois descendência  de Abraão, e herdeiros conforme a promessa.
